summary: This chunk details the CCRU Pandemonium Matrix system, a modern fiction-theory apparatus for Lemurian Time-Sorcery. It defines the Numogram structure (zones 0-9 with specific properties), time-systems (Time-Circuit, Warp, Plex), demon classes (Chronodemons, Amphidemons, Xenodemons), and specific Rites/Paths with zone-net identifiers from the Book of Paths concordance.
key_passages: TIER-C MODERN RETROFIT / FICTION-THEORY ACCELERATIONIST APPARATUS — not a historical grimoire.
Each syzygy's arithmetic difference defines a current, or link to a tractor zone. These currents are the numogram's main flows.
Each zone number in the numogram, when digitally cumulated, defines a gate's value.
Chronodemons: These represent varieties of distance within the time-circuit.
Amphidemons: They represent ruptures in the time-circuit, signifying openings to the Outside.
